summary: Multiple fronts active across the Middle East: Iranian missile strikes hit Jordan's Al-Salti air base (Sept 9), Saudi Arabia plans to bypass damaged east-west pipeline segment within days with full recovery in ~6 weeks, and IDF Chief of Staff Zamir demands Lebanese army improve effectiveness to demilitarize south of the Litani. Israeli forces destroyed displaced Lebanese homes in Zoutar al-Sharqiya. Mahan Air cancels flights to Muscat, Istanbul, and Ankara. Iran-linked cyber malware CHOSEN BRICK targets journalists and opponents globally.

sections.executive_summary: Iranian missile strikes confirmed on Jordan's Al-Salti air base (Sept 9) mark a significant escalation crossing a sovereign Arab state border. IDF Chief of Staff Zamir demands Lebanese army effectiveness improvement as precondition for demilitarizing south of Litani, signaling expanded Lebanon operations.

sections.threat_assessment: Iranian missile strikes on Jordan's Al-Salti air base represent a significant escalation risking broader regional confrontation. Hezbollah capabilities south of the Litani remain a primary IDF objective, with Zamir explicitly linking Lebanese army effectiveness to operational progress. Iranian cyber infrastructure via CHOSEN BRICK malware poses ongoing espionage threat against journalists and dissidents across UK, US, and Netherlands. Houthi positions in Dhubab, Taiz continue to be struck, indicating sustained Yemen theater activity. The convergence of energy infrastructure attacks (Saudi pipeline, Iraqi oil facility) and airspace closures over Iran creates multi-domain instability.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia moving to bypass pipeline damage within days signals rapid operational recovery planning but vulnerability of east-west energy corridors. US internal division evident as Rep. Mikx blocks $2.8B bomb sale to Israel, while VP Vance warns Middle East withdrawal triggers global energy crisis. Trump publicly signals desire for Iran deal proximity. Iranian FM emphasizes China strategic partnership as diplomatic counterweight. Jordan's airbase strike may prompt renewed demand for US defensive commitments in the region.
sections.intelligence_notes: Unverified claims circulate regarding US attacks on Iranian fast boats and Tehran-Qom drone assassination attempt — treat with caution pending corroboration. Iranian state media reports pro-government gatherings at 200 consecutive nights, suggesting organized domestic support campaign. Mahan Air flight cancellations indicate aviation sector disruption extending beyond conflict zone. Iranian FM's China consultations may signal diplomatic backchannel amid military escalation. CHOSEN BRICK malware attribution to Iranian government cyber actors since 2025 warrants enhanced defensive posture for journalists and dissidents.
